rules_text:
# *RULES*
+- **KEEP OUR COMMUNITY STRONG**
Any hate speech, mean/unnecessary comments, racist jokes, tragic world events jokes (Ex. 911), etc. **WILL RESULT IN AN IMMEDIAT BAN/LONG TIMEOUT** we want to keep this server a safe place for people to talk, meet new people, play roblox together, etc. The stuff listed above ruins that for everyone! BE NICE
+- **BE KIND**
Making fun of someone for their progress in game is not permitted here. Doing so can result in a server AND guild ban OR long timeouts/ kicked from guild
+- **KEEP IT APPROPRIATE**
Swearing is okay but know your limits. **ANY** NSFW content is strictly prohibited from our server to help keep everyone safe
+- **NO EXPLOITING**
Using ANY type of exploits are highly prohibited in our server and we do NOT allow any of them in our guild!
+- **NO SCAMMING**
We currently don't offer a trading system in our server but if another member has proof of you scamming you **WILL** be banned immediately and kicked from the guild 
+- **NO PROMOTING**
Our server is for **OUR** Guild only. If a message is sent promoting a guild/server you will be banned.
+- **NO BEGGING**
If you don't make the guild team for the week we need you to understand we cant help you. Unless in the future we end up making a **B** Guild team to we can only take 50 players to help us for the week. If you don't make it join another guild and just be ready to try again the next week.
+- **NO BRIBING**
Whether its an <@&1521774545835659338> or Another member bribing is NOT allowed. Ex: Offering someone R$ to leave, Offering an Elder pets/fruits to join.
+- **NO 3RD PARTY INVITING**
We don't allow members to invite other members to their guilds via our server. This will result in a ban.

**More Will Be Added Soon!**
